channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Vinny Del Negro | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Vinny Del Negro from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Vinny Del Negro
item.description:
ClipsDeAndre Jordan on firing of Vinny Del Negro:

“I was definitely surprised about it but I wish him the best. That's tough losing a coach”

DeAndre Jordan on Vinny Del Negro, May 24, 2013. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Vinny Del Negro
item.description:
Joan Nielsen:Matt Barnes on Del Negro:

“People don’t understand: it’s hard to manage people like us, young people that have money and egos.”

Matt Barnes on Vinny Del Negro, May 4, 2013. Source: Twitter @JoanNiesen.

item.title: John Paxson on Vinny Del Negro
item.description:
“It was a heat-of-the-moment thing, and I was very frustrated with the way we were playing. “What also disappointed me is that [Del Negro] never owned up to making a mistake. That says more about him than it does me. I was trying to protect my player [Noah, who was coming back from injuries], I did it in the wrong way and I’m not proud of that.”

John Paxson on Vinny Del Negro, Mar 8, 2011. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.
